name: Habitat Conservation Fund
summary: Cost-shared funding from the Nova Scotia Department of Natural Resources for wildlife habitat enhancement, land acquisition, research and education, with an annual October deadline.

eligibility.rule: Requests no more than one year of project funding per grant
For a continuing project, varies from and builds on the previous project
Not habitat inventory, tree planting (beyond a minor part), fisheries management or a government responsibility

documents: Letters of support from matching funding sources
Conflict of Interest Declaration, if required
Research proposal and principal applicant résumé, if applying for research

calls.label: Annual round
calls.recurring: Applications are due 15 October each year.

geography.quote: The Habitat Conservation Fund was established under the Nova Scotia Wildlife Act to help protect and enhance wildlife habitats.

access.quote: Applications can be submitted online at Nova Scotia Habitat Conservation Fund- Simple Forms service

co_finance_required.quote: The FUND will subsidize projects on a cost-shared basis not to exceed 75% of total project cost.

effort.quote: Submit your completed application form, budget and activity table, letters of support and conflict of interest declaration (if required) online by 15 October.

eligibility.quote: The maximum length of a project that will be funded is one year.
Applications to continue a previously funded project must demonstrate how the current proposal varies from and builds upon knowledge gained from the previously funded project.

Habitat inventories; Tree planting programs (unless a minor part of a broader habitat conservation project); Fisheries management projects; Projects which are a provincial or federal management responsibility;

co_finance.quote: The FUND will subsidize projects on a cost-shared basis not to exceed 75% of total project cost. The Habitat Conservation Fund will not contribute to administration fees. Matching funding may include in-kind and/or financial resources, and letters of support from matching funders must accompany the Application Form.

after_award.quote: Progress reports must be submitted on a regular basis (as defined in the grant agreement), or as requested by the FUND.

documents.quote: complete the Budget and Activity Table (Excel). Note there are three separate tabs to fill. amalgamate letters of support from matching funding sources into a single PDF.
complete the Conflict of Interest Declaration (PDF) (if required)
research submissions must include a research proposal and resumé for the principal applicant.
